notes: v1.15 (2026-07-08): Disbanded LA-CENTRAL. Its 142 ZIPs were split 87 to LA-WEST (Alex Acuna) and 55 to LA-EAST (Zoila Ladd). The two ZIPs not in the original re-zone request (90742 Sunset Beach, 91046 Verdugo City) were also moved to LA-WEST so the zone could be fully emptied. LA-CENTRAL removed from both the zones map and the zip_assignments rule. Zoila Ladd now owns LA-EAST only; Alex Acuna owns LA-WEST + SAC-METRO. New LA counts: LA-WEST 307, LA-EAST 205 (LA total unchanged at 512). index.html and geocode_and_assign.js need no code changes (the legend/manager pills and the nightly geocoder are data-driven from zones.json). Run migrateZoneIds() after committing to re-stamp existing rows by ZIP: the 87 LA-WEST ZIPs change manager Zoila Ladd -> Alex Acuna; the 55 LA-EAST ZIPs stay with Zoila but change zone_id from LA-CENTRAL to LA-EAST.

Chicago-CENTRAL.label: Chicago Central & Western Suburbs
Chicago-CENTRAL.description: NW Cook (Schaumburg/Hoffman Estates/Streamwood/Hanover Park/Palatine 60067), west DuPage (Wheaton/Naperville/Glen Ellyn/Bloomingdale/Bartlett), all Kane (Aurora/Elgin/Geneva/St. Charles), all DeKalb, all Kendall (Yorkville/Oswego), all Grundy (Morris), all LaSalle (Ottawa/Streator), west Will (Plainfield/Bolingbrook/Romeoville), west Kankakee, south McHenry (Crystal Lake/Algonquin/Cary/Lake in the Hills), and two west Lake-IL ZIPs (Barrington 60010, Wauconda 60084).

Chicago-SOUTH.label: Chicago City, South Suburbs & NW Indiana
Chicago-SOUTH.description: Almost all of Cook County (the city of Chicago plus nearly every suburb except the NW sliver), east DuPage (Itasca/Addison/Lombard/Downers Grove/Woodridge), east Will (Joliet/Lockport/Manhattan/Lemont), east Kankakee (Kankakee/Bourbonnais/Manteno), the south Lake-IL east-shore corridor (Highland Park/Lake Forest/Libertyville/Vernon Hills/Deerfield/Buffalo Grove/Mundelein/Lake Zurich/Lake Bluff/Highwood/Lincolnshire), and all of NW Indiana (Lake, Porter, LaPorte, Newton, Jasper counties).

Milwaukee + N. IL.label: Milwaukee + N. Illinois
Milwaukee + N. IL.description: All of the Milwaukee DMA (Milwaukee/Waukesha/Racine/Kenosha/Sheboygan/Dodge/Walworth/Washington/Jefferson/Ozaukee counties in WI), the northern strip of Lake County IL (Waukegan/Gurnee/Antioch/Zion/Round Lake/Grayslake/Wadsworth — roughly north of lat 42.31), the northern strip of McHenry County IL (McHenry/Woodstock/Harvard/Hebron/Richmond/Spring Grove), and Great Lakes Naval Station (60088).

LA-WEST.label: LA — West Basin, Valley & Coast
LA-WEST.description: West LA basin and coast, South Bay, PV peninsula, Wilmington, Malibu, all of Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Glendale, Burbank, Santa Clarita Valley and all of Ventura County. Absorbed from the disbanded LA-CENTRAL (v1.15): the central LA basin (downtown, Boyle Heights, East LA, Lincoln Heights, El Sereno), Eagle Rock/Highland Park, the SE-LA gateway cities (Commerce, Vernon, Bell, Downey, Montebello, Pico Rivera, Santa Fe Springs, Norwalk, Cerritos, Artesia, Bellflower, Lakewood, Paramount, Signal Hill, Hawaiian Gardens, Los Alamitos, Seal Beach, Sunset Beach), the west San Gabriel Valley (Alhambra, Monterey Park, San Gabriel, Rosemead, Temple City, El Monte, Arcadia, Sierra Madre, South Pasadena, Pasadena, Altadena, La Canada Flintridge, Montrose, Verdugo City), and north/coastal Orange County (Anaheim, Fullerton, Buena Park, La Palma, Cypress, Stanton, Garden Grove, Westminster, Fountain Valley, Huntington Beach, La Mirada).

LA-EAST.label: LA — Inland Empire & South OC
LA-EAST.description: Inland Empire (Ontario, San Bernardino, Riverside, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga), south Orange County (Irvine, Mission Viejo, San Juan Capistrano), the eastern Mojave high desert and Inyo County desert (Death Valley, Bishop, Lone Pine). Absorbed from the disbanded LA-CENTRAL (v1.15): the east San Gabriel Valley (Azusa, Baldwin Park, Covina, West Covina, Glendora, San Dimas, La Verne, Claremont, Pomona, Diamond Bar, Walnut, La Puente, City of Industry, Hacienda Heights, Rowland Heights, Duarte, Monrovia), Whittier and La Habra, the Antelope Valley high desert (Lancaster, Palmdale, Acton, Littlerock, Pearblossom, Lake Hughes, Valyermo), and north-central Orange County (Santa Ana, Costa Mesa, Newport Beach, Orange).

SAC-METRO.label: Sacramento Metro & Foothills
SAC-METRO.description: Sacramento-Stockton-Modesto DMA: the Sacramento metro, Stockton and San Joaquin Valley, Modesto/Stanislaus, the Solano and Yolo corridor, and the Sierra foothill counties (Placer, El Dorado, Amador, Calaveras, Tuolumne, Nevada, Plumas, Sierra). 365 Tier 1 ZIPs across 17 counties.

assignment_rules.description: v1.8 (2026-05-19): Every ZIP in the LA + Chicago + Milwaukee DMAs assigned to a zone. v1.8 LA restructure: 4 zones -> 3. LA-NORTH dissolved; its ZIPs split between LA-WEST (SFV/Glendale/Burbank/Santa Clarita/Ventura), LA-CENTRAL (Antelope Valley desert) and LA-EAST (Inyo County desert). All Long Beach ZIPs consolidated into LA-WEST. 12 LA-County east-valley ZIPs moved from old LA-INLAND into LA-CENTRAL. Each ZIP reassignment is a single-line edit to the array below. v1.9 adds SAC-METRO (365 Sacramento DMA ZIPs). Must evaluate before market_match / county_list fallbacks. v1.12 (2026-05-20): Chicago/Milwaukee market restructured. Ana Lopes now owns only the WI DMA plus the northern strips of Lake/McHenry IL plus Great Lakes 60088. Elizabeth Varela owns the SW IL collar (Kane/DeKalb/Kendall/Grundy/LaSalle, west DuPage, west Will, NW Cook, west Kankakee, south McHenry, plus Barrington/Wauconda). Jorge Rodriguez owns Cook County proper, east DuPage/Will/Kankakee, south Lake-IL east shore, and all NW Indiana.
Entire Milwaukee market goes to the combined Milwaukee + N. IL zone.

polygon_overlays._comment: Approximate visual polygons for the map's zone overlays. These DO NOT drive assignment — they're cosmetic. Assignment is governed entirely by assignment_rules above. Polygons are arrays of [lat, lng] vertices.

tuning_notes: If Chicago Central managers push back on volume (currently 265 each), the agreed adjustment is to shift Cook County far-north suburbs (Evanston, Skokie, Niles) into the Milwaukee + N. IL zone. To do this, add a rule above chicago_central that matches Cook County + lat >= ~42.0 (or specific zips) and assigns Milwaukee + N. IL.

LA polygon vertices follow approximate freeway alignments: 710 (~lng -118.18 to -118.20), 57 (~lng -117.86), 55 (~lng -117.87), 605 (~lng -118.10), and the 5/101 in downtown (~lng -118.22). To shift a boundary, find the rule and adjust the vertex coordinates. A 0.01° change is roughly 1km.
Albert/Julie boundary at the Hollywood Hills is a horizontal line at lat 34.13. Pasadena/Glendale (Julie) and the San Fernando Valley (Albert) are separated by this latitude.

Alex/Julie split in downtown LA uses the 5 freeway / LA river (lng -118.225) as the boundary in the band lat 33.99-34.10, and the 710 (lng -118.18) elsewhere. This gives Julie a slice of east downtown.
Polygon overlays are cosmetic only. Edit them to change what the map renders. Edit the assignment_rules polygons to change actual zone assignment.
Account managers were updated to real names on 2026-05-01: Alex Acuna, Albert Trevino, Julie Lin, Zoila Ladd (Chicago/Milwaukee still TBD).

Changed Julie's color from green (#16a34a) to vivid purple (#9333ea) for better visibility. Visual overlays now match assignment polygons exactly (flush, not inset).

2026-05-01 (v1.2): Fixed pre-existing gap on Malibu coast. Alex's western edge now extends to lng -118.75, sharing a boundary with Albert's new Ventura coast step. Malibu now properly assigned to Alex.

2026-05-01 (v1.3): Chicago Central/South split is no longer a flat horizontal line. South now claims a downtown lakefront corridor (lng -87.75 to lake, up to lat 41.90) and the Berwyn area (lng -87.85 to -87.75, up to lat 41.86). Oak Park stays in Central. 2026-05-07 (v1.4): zip_assignments rule replaces polygon-based assignment. To move ZIP X from zone A to zone B, edit assignment_rules[0].params.zips: remove X from A's array, add to B's array. Apps Script update is pending — until then, the nightly geocoder still uses the polygon rules from v1.3 (which remain in the bound script even though they're absent from this file). The map's coloring uses zip_assignments only.

2026-05-07 (v1.5): LA shake-up. Renamed zone IDs to be neutral (LA-NORTH/WEST/EAST/INLAND). Swapped Alex↔Albert as managers of North↔West. Moved 40 ZIPs (Bel Air → Glendale strip) into LA-NORTH. The Apps Script's migrateZoneIds_() function rewrote all existing zone_id and account_manager values in the Sheet by re-running the assignment dispatch — so any address whose ZIP is in the snap rule got the correct new zone + manager automatically.

2026-05-07 (v1.6): Moved 25 SBD ZIPs (high desert + eastern Mojave) from LA-NORTH to LA-INLAND. Alex Acuna's territory shrinks to metro LA / Antelope Valley / Inyo County desert. Zoila Ladd's territory expands to cover the full San Bernardino County extent outside Inyo (Riverside County + all of SBD).

2026-05-19 (v1.8): LA restructured 4 zones -> 3. LA-NORTH dissolved, Alex Acuna off the LA market (-> Sacramento, Task 2). Single zip_list assignment, no new rule type. index.html updated: market detection now reads the geojson market_name property (marketNameToMarket) instead of guessing market from state, so the two CA markets (Los Angeles, Sacramento) are distinguished correctly. Liz lost 79 ZIPs to Jorge (most of Cook + east DuPage) and gained 81 from Jorge (LaSalle/Kane/Kendall/Grundy/DeKalb/west DuPage/west Will/west Kankakee/NW Cook) plus 12 from Ana (south McHenry, Barrington/Wauconda). Jorge net +10.
